svg.title: One common rotation gives one vanishing difference
svg.desc: Three panels illustrate evaluated complex vectors. First, c equals three, d equals minus three and g equals three i. The scaled differences are minus three and three i, with sum E equal to minus three plus three i, outside the circle of radius three. Second, multiplication by omega rotates every vector, including E, counterclockwise by 120 degrees. Third, dividing each configuration by its own c value brings both normalized E arrows to minus one plus i. Their exact difference is zero. These schematic values are not an order-36 Hadamard construction and do not assert the all-ones coefficient congruence.
svg.text: Node 7 · One rotation, one vanishing sum
Construct the vector, rotate it with the triple, then cancel the rotation by dividing.
The sum is outside the radius-three circle.
Schematic continuation of Node 6, not an order-36 Hadamard construction.
